description: SBOM vulnerability audit — Audit a software bill of materials against OSV.dev: send sbom= (CycloneDX JSON/XML or SPDX JSON/tag-value), url= to an SBOM file (GitHub blob links work) or purls= comma-separated package URLs. Checks up to 1000 components in one batch across npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, Cargo, NuGet, RubyGems and more; returns per-package advisories with GHSA/CVE aliases de-duplicated, severity and CVSS 3 score, fixed versions, the upgradeTo version that clears them all, and a CLEAN / REVIEW / UPGRADE NOW verdict. Example: /v1/dev/sbom-audit?purls=pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.15,pkg:pypi/django@3.2.1 Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dev_sbom_audit
